compiled_state.description:
## Context
This replacement tree consolidates the retired 1,499-ticket per-file audit into six workstream stories and 117 path-disjoint remediation leaves. The leaves cover 1,514 distinct file-impact paths: 1,499 migrated paths plus 15 paths added without retired-source mappings. This epic makes no repository edits.

## Plan
- Complete and close every leaf through its recorded checks, independent semantic review, Gerrit gates, merge, and completion verification.
- Close each workstream after it records the exact migration and execution inventories required by its plan.
- Concatenate the six story migration TSVs, add `story-alias`, sort by path, and store the 1,499-row result in a dedicated `session_log` linked `relates_to` this epic. Schema: `path<TAB>story-alias<TAB>replacement-leaf-alias<TAB>source-ticket-alias<TAB>scope-count<TAB>file-impact-count`.
- Concatenate the six story execution TSVs, add `story-alias`, sort by path, and store the 1,514-row result in the same log. Schema: `path<TAB>story-alias<TAB>replacement-leaf-alias<TAB>scope-count<TAB>file-impact-count<TAB>source-count`.
- Record both row counts and SHA-256 values in the epic completion comment, together with the six story-log ids.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All six workstream stories are closed.
- [ ] All 117 remediation leaves are closed.
- [ ] The epic migration TSV contains exactly 1,499 rows.
- [ ] The migration TSV contains exactly 1,499 distinct migrated paths.
- [ ] The migration TSV contains exactly 1,499 distinct retired source tickets.
- [ ] Every retired source ticket has exactly one net-active live replacement leaf.
- [ ] Every migration row has `scope-count=1`.
- [ ] Every migration row has `file-impact-count=1`.
- [ ] The epic execution TSV contains exactly 1,514 rows.
- [ ] The execution TSV contains exactly 1,514 distinct paths.
- [ ] Every execution row has `scope-count=1`.
- [ ] Every execution row has `file-impact-count=1`.
- [ ] Exactly 1,499 execution rows have `source-count=1`.
- [ ] Exactly 15 execution rows have `source-count=0`.
- [ ] Every migrated Scope constraint has a non-author `semantic-preservation=PASS` row with immutable before/final citations.
- [ ] Every migrated consumer contract has a non-author `semantic-preservation=PASS` row with immutable before/final citations.
- [ ] Every edited prose block has a non-author `bloat-removal=PASS` row.
- [ ] Every recorded leaf verification command exits 0 at its cited commit.
- [ ] Every leaf completion trail records its Gerrit Change-Id, `LLM-Review +1`, `Verified +1`, and zero unresolved comments.
- [ ] Every leaf completion trail records Gerrit `MERGED` status and the exact merged commit reachable from `origin/main`.
- [ ] The epic log records both combined TSVs and all six story-log ids.
- [ ] The epic completion comment cites the epic log and records both row counts and both SHA-256 values.

## Completion boundary
Close this epic only after every descendant is closed and every inventory check above passes.
